list_openai_models: list all available pretrained OpenAI CLIP model names
load_openai_model_by_name: load a pretrained OpenAI CLIP model by name onto the default device
load_openai_model_with_precision: load an OpenAI CLIP model with fp32 precision on CPU
load_openai_model_from_path: load an OpenAI CLIP model from a local checkpoint file path
load_openai_model_with_cache: load an OpenAI CLIP model and cache downloaded weights to a directory
